name: Widened battleground players receive defensive gear catch-up without offensive side effects
contract: A level 12 Human Sun Cleric (cleric, class 27, Plate, RebornArmor 1) and a level 12 Human Pyromancer (pyro, class 24, Cloth, RebornArmor 1) enter a 10-29 Warsong Gulch against two level 29 Undead Necromancers (top, top2). Cleric (49 baseline armor including 13 starter gear armor, 0 Stamina) receives +207 gear Health (365 - 158) on top of its +291 bare health lift (+498 total) and +493 Reborn Plate armor (round(1046 - 552.8)); pyro (8 starter armor) receives +207 gear Health on top of +276 bare lift (+483 total) and +110 Reborn Cloth armor (round(221 - 110.8)); top receives 0 health and 0 armor lift. OutputRatio stays unchanged at 581/290 for cleric. Inside the BG at 500 current health, equipping Ironheart Chain 3166 (+4 Stamina = +40 HP, 127 Reborn armor, replacing the 8-armor starter chest for +119 net), swapping the starter two-handed mace 629944 for Worn Shortsword 25 (0 Stamina, 0 Armor) in slot 15, and equipping Dwarven Defender 6187 (+3 Stamina = +30 HP, 318 Reborn shield armor) keeps raw current health at 500 (zero free heal), raises max_health strictly (+40 then +30), and triggers the Shield armor catch-up (+326 = round(644 - 318), bringing lifted armor gain to 493 + 119 + 318 + 326 = 1256 and total armor from 49 to 1305). A +50 Stamina Fortitude buff 1243 stacks on top (+500 max_health). Sun Cleric Blessed Armor 300334->301006 grants floor(486 * 3 / 125) = 11 Spell Power and Bladed Armor 49393 grants floor(486 / 50) = 9 Attack Power, and with +30% armor Warlord's Bulwark 47975 armor rises to int32(1305 * 1.30) = 1696 (+1647) while Bladed Armor grants floor((1696 - lround(819 * 1.30)) / 50) = floor(631 / 50) = 12 AP instead of 33, proving the 819 BG armor lift is excluded under percentage multipliers too. Equipping Azuremoon Band 521111 (+2 Stamina = +20 HP, 0 armor, 0 durability -> gear.health = 90 <= 158, +588 max_health) and then casting permanent enchant 15429 (requiredLevel 0, +75 Health) onto equipped Sunlit Pants 2000063 mid-BG refreshes lift immediately without an item swap, pushing gear.health to 165 (> B_own = 158) so lift shrinks 207 -> 200 and max_health rises by +68 net (to +656) with raw health unchanged at 500. Swapping back to two-handed mace 629944 auto-unequips the shield (-30 gear.health -> 135 <= 158, growing gear health lift back to 207 for +633 max_health delta) and strips both shield armor (318) and shield lift (326) back to +612 armor. Re-equipping Worn Shortsword 25 and Dwarven Defender 6187 restores +1256 armor, after which wearing all equipment to 0 durability removes item/enchant stats on durability gear (leaving Azuremoon Band 521111 +20 HP and zero-durability Sunlit Shoes 2000064 2 armor intact) and strips the broken shield's armor catch-up (+518 max_health, +482 armor = 36 base + 2 intact shoes + 493 Plate lift - 49). Casting permanent enchant 15439 (+110 Armor, requiredLevel 0) onto pyro's equipped Kindled Pants 2000054 mid-BG refreshes Cloth armor lift immediately, pushing gear.armor to 118 (> 110.8) so lift shrinks 110 -> 103 (+213 armor instead of +220). Leaving restores +20 max_health and -11 armor delta (11 of 13 starter armor broken, 2-armor Sunlit Shoes intact) on cleric, and +0/+110 on pyro.
